# ZiT img2img + Flux Upscaler — Setup Instructions

## Requirements
- RunPod with ComfyUI installed
- At least 24GB VRAM recommended

---

## Step 1 — Find Your ComfyUI Path
Run this in your terminal first to confirm your path:
```bash
ls /workspace
```
If you see **runpod-slim** then your path is `/workspace/runpod-slim/ComfyUI`
If you see **ComfyUI** directly then your path is `/workspace/ComfyUI`
Replace the path in the script below to match yours.

---

## Step 2 — Download Everything📂✅
Paste this entire script into your RunPod terminal and press Enter.

```bash
mkdir -p /workspace/ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models \
  /workspace/ComfyUI/models/text_encoders \
  /workspace/ComfyUI/models/vae \
  /workspace/ComfyUI/models/ultralytics/bbox \
  /workspace/ComfyUI/models/sams && \

echo "=== Downloading Z-Image Turbo models ===" && \
wget -O /workspace/ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors \
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors && \
wget -O /workspace/ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors \
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors && \
wget -O /workspace/ComfyUI/models/vae/ae.safetensors \
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors && \

echo "=== Downloading Flux Klein 9B models ===" && \
wget -O /workspace/ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/flux-2-klein-9b-kv-fp8.safetensors \
  https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv-fp8/resolve/main/flux-2-klein-9b-kv-fp8.safetensors && \
wget -O /workspace/ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors \
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed.safetensors && \
wget -O /workspace/ComfyUI/models/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors \
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/resolve/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors && \

echo "=== Downloading Impact Pack models ===" && \
wget -O /workspace/ComfyUI/models/ultralytics/bbox/face_yolov8m.pt \
  https://huggingface.co/Bingsu/adetailer/resolve/main/face_yolov8m.pt && \
wget -O /workspace/ComfyUI/models/sams/sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth \
  https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/segment_anything/sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth && \

echo "=== Installing Custom Nodes ===" && \
cd /workspace/ComfyUI/custom_nodes && \
git clone https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack 2>/dev/null || (cd ComfyUI-Impact-Pack && git pull) && \
git clone https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack 2>/dev/null || (cd ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack && git pull) && \
git clone https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF 2>/dev/null || (cd RES4LYF && git pull) && \
git clone https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy 2>/dev/null || (cd rgthree-comfy && git pull) && \
git clone https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes 2>/dev/null || (cd ComfyUI-KJNodes && git pull) && \
cd ComfyUI-Impact-Pack && pip install -r requirements.txt --break-system-packages 2>/dev/null && \
cd ../ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack && pip install -r requirements.txt --break-system-packages 2>/dev/null && \
cd ../ComfyUI-KJNodes && pip install -r requirements.txt --break-system-packages 2>/dev/null && \

echo "=== ALL DONE — Restart ComfyUI now ==="
```

---

## Step 3 — Add Your LoRAs
Upload your LoRA files manually to:
```
/workspace/ComfyUI/models/loras/
```

Required LoRAs for this workflow:
- `C4nd3_zit__lora_2000.safetensors` — your character LoRA
- `igbaddie-klein.safetensors`
- `FameGrid_Revolution_ZIB_B.safetensors`
- `INSTARAW_flux-klein_char_lor.safetensors`

---

## Step 4 — Restart ComfyUI
After the script finishes restart ComfyUI and load this workflow.

---

## Workflow Notes
- **ZiT img2img** section (blue group) — main image generation
- **Flux Upscaler** section (gold group) — upscales and sharpens the output
- To bypass the upscaler: right click the gold group → **Bypass**
- Recommended denoise: **0.80** in ClownsharKSampler
- Recommended resolution: **768x1280** for 9:16 vertical output
- Upscaler megapixels: **3.00** for full quality, **2.00** for faster test runs
